sentences.en: President Trump is asking Republican primary voters to reject a Republican congressman that they've elected seven times before.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统要求共和党初选选民拒绝一位他们之前已经选出过七次的共和党国会议员。

sentences.en: His name is Thomas Massey.
sentences.zh: 他的名字是托马斯·马西。

sentences.en: Representative Thomas Massey.
sentences.zh: 众议员托马斯·马西。

sentences.en: Massey's a complete and total disaster as a congressman and frankly as a human being.
sentences.zh: 马西作为国会议员，坦率地说作为一个人，简直是一场彻底的灾难。

sentences.en: A fiercely proud conservative who has broken with Trump on just a handful of votes.
sentences.zh: 他是一位极其自豪的保守派，在投票中仅有少数几次与特朗普意见不合。

sentences.en: We've got to get rid of this loser.
sentences.zh: 我们必须除掉这个失败者。

sentences.en: This guy is bad.
sentences.zh: 这家伙很糟糕。

sentences.en: He's disloyal to the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 他对共和党不忠。

sentences.en: He's disloyal to the people of Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 他对肯塔基州人民不忠。

sentences.en: And most importantly, he is disloyal to the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他对美利坚合众国不忠。

sentences.en: And he's got to be voted out of office as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 他必须尽快被投票赶出办公室。

sentences.en: Instead, Trump wants Kentucky Republicans to elect his hand-picked challenger,
sentences.zh: 相反，特朗普希望肯塔基州的共和党人选出他亲自挑选的挑战者，

sentences.en: Ed Galron, in what has become the most expensive House primary in American history.
sentences.zh: 埃德·加尔隆，这场初选已成为美国历史上最昂贵的众议院初选。

sentences.en: On the other hand, Ed Galron has my complete and total endorsement.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，埃德·加尔隆得到了我完全且彻底的支持。

sentences.en: He's a true American hero and he's a great patriot.
sentences.zh: 他是一位真正的美国英雄，也是一位伟大的爱国者。

sentences.en: Today, Times political correspondent Robert Draper and Daily producer Caitlin O'Keefe travel to Kentucky to find out whether a popular congressman can still dissent
sentences.zh: 今天，《时报》政治记者罗伯特·德雷珀和《每日新闻》制片人凯特琳·奥基夫前往肯塔基州，探究一位受欢迎的国会议员是否还能对

sentences.en: from an increasingly unpopular president.
sentences.zh: 一位日益不受欢迎的总统提出异议。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, May 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月19日，星期二。

sentences.en: Robert, welcome back to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特，欢迎回到《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me back.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你再次邀请我。

sentences.en: Anytime.
sentences.zh: 随时欢迎。

sentences.en: We have established quite clearly on the show that President Trump has decided to use these
sentences.zh: 我们已经在节目中非常明确地指出，特朗普总统决定利用这些

sentences.en: midterm primary elections to try to take out his rivals within the Republican Party and impose as much discipline on the party as humanly possible.
sentences.zh: 中期初选来试图清除他在共和党内的竞争对手，并尽可能地对党内施加纪律。

sentences.en: And so far, he's largely succeeded in that goal, taking out Republicans who fought him in Indiana and, just a few days ago, in Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他在这一目标上基本取得了成功，清除了在印第安纳州以及就在几天前在路易斯安那州与他作对的共和党人。

sentences.en: And there's one last revenge race that remains.
sentences.zh: 现在还剩下最后一场复仇之战。

sentences.en: And in your capacity as a chronicler of the Republican Party and the fights within it, you decided that that race was the most important or at least the most interesting,
sentences.zh: 作为共和党及其内部斗争的记录者，你认为那场竞选是最重要的，或者至少是最有趣的，

sentences.en: which is why I'm talking to you from the place where that race is about to occur, Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我从那场竞选即将发生的地点——肯塔基州——与你交谈。

sentences.en: Why did you decide that that primary was so important?
sentences.zh: 你为什么认为那场初选如此重要？

sentences.en: Largely because Thomas Massey, the seventh-term incumbent of Kentucky's fourth congressional
sentences.zh: 很大程度上是因为托马斯·马西，肯塔基州第四国会选区

sentences.en: district, has been more defiant pretty much than all the other Republicans put together.
sentences.zh: 的七届连任议员，他比其他所有共和党人加起来还要叛逆。

sentences.en: Repeatedly, Massey has defied Trump's wishes and has seemed cheerfully uncaring about what
sentences.zh: 马西一再违背特朗普的意愿，而且似乎对特朗普希望他做什么

sentences.en: Trump wants him to do.
sentences.zh: 表现得满不在乎。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's nothing nuanced or hedging about his brand of, I'm doing my own thing here.
sentences.zh: 他那种“我行我素”的风格没有任何细微差别或含糊其辞。

sentences.en: Not in the least, no.
sentences.zh: 一点也不，确实如此。

sentences.en: And as a result of this, Trump has endorsed an opponent against him and is encouraging big Republican donors to back that opponent.
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普支持了一位反对他的对手，并鼓励共和党大金主支持该对手。

sentences.en: And tell us more about that opponent.
sentences.zh: 给我们多介绍一下那位对手吧。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The man that Trump has handpicked to oppose Thomas Massey is Ed Galrine, a dairy farmer,
sentences.zh: 特朗普亲自挑选来对抗托马斯·马西的人是埃德·加尔隆，一位奶农、

sentences.en: Navy SEAL, and Trump stalwart who has pledged to stand alongside Trump and help get his agenda passed.
sentences.zh: 海豹突击队队员，也是特朗普的坚定支持者，他承诺站在特朗普一边，帮助通过他的议程。

sentences.en: This is a familiar landscape for Massey.
sentences.zh: 这对马西来说是一个熟悉的局面。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's been through this before.
sentences.zh: 他以前经历过这种情况。

sentences.en: In 2018, Trump wanted Massey taken down, and it didn't bear any fruit.
sentences.zh: 2018年，特朗普想把马西拉下马，但没有成功。

sentences.en: But this time, things are a great deal closer, where Massey has comfortably won his primaries, sometimes with 81 percent of the vote.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，情况要接近得多，马西过去曾轻松赢得初选，有时得票率高达81%。

sentences.en: This time around, the polls suggest that the two candidates are dead even.
sentences.zh: 这一次，民调显示两位候选人势均力敌。

sentences.en: And what's so interesting to me about this primary is that if ever there was a moment where somebody might defy political gravity
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这场初选最有趣的地方在于，如果说有那么一个时刻，有人可能会无视政治重力，

sentences.en: and survive this routine onslaught from Trump when he thinks you've dissented too much,
sentences.zh: 在特朗普认为你异议太多而发起的例行猛攻中幸存下来，

sentences.en: it might be Massey in this moment because of the economy we're in, with the inflation we have, and the unpopularity of the war that the president started.
sentences.zh: 那可能就是现在的马西，因为我们所处的经济环境、通货膨胀，以及总统发动的战争不受欢迎。

sentences.en: But perhaps if ever there was a moment for someone to stand up to Trump and actually survive their repercussions, it might be this moment.
sentences.zh: 但也许，如果说有那么一个时刻，有人可以站出来对抗特朗普并真正从后果中幸存下来，那可能就是现在。

sentences.en: If, in fact, Galrine does win, then this will suggest, among other things, that Trump's stranglehold over the Republican Party remains pretty much absolute.
sentences.zh: 如果加尔隆真的赢了，那么这至少表明，特朗普对共和党的铁腕控制依然是绝对的。

sentences.en: If, on the other hand, Massey prevails, lives to fight another day, then it may well suggest that at a time when Trump has exerted so much in an effort to take down a candidate
sentences.zh: 另一方面，如果马西获胜并继续战斗，那么这很可能表明，在特朗普投入如此多努力试图拉下候选人

sentences.en: but has failed to do so, that perhaps Trump's grip is not what it once was
sentences.zh: 却未能成功的时候，特朗普的掌控力可能已不如从前，

sentences.en: and may in turn embolden not just Massey but others like him to challenge a president whose unfavorables are on the rise.
sentences.zh: 这反过来可能会鼓励不仅是马西，还有其他像他一样的人去挑战一位负面评价正在上升的总统。

sentences.en: Well, Robert, remind us how Representative Massey came to be so defiant when it comes to Trump and why the president finds him to be so intolerable.
sentences.zh: 那么，罗伯特，提醒我们一下，马西众议员是如何变得如此反抗特朗普的，以及为什么总统觉得他如此令人无法容忍。

sentences.en: I think that it's in keeping with the brand that Massey has held up from the outset of his political career
sentences.zh: 我认为这与马西从职业生涯之初就坚持的品牌形象是一致的，

sentences.en: as this individualist, a confirmed eccentric, a kind of fiscal absolutist, a person who is for individual rights, that he would hold the line on things like no foreign aid,
sentences.zh: 作为一个个人主义者、一个公认的怪人、一种财政绝对主义者、一个支持个人权利的人，他会在诸如“不提供外国援助”之类的事情上坚守底线，

sentences.en: and that includes no carve-out exemption for Israel.
sentences.zh: 这包括不为以色列提供任何例外豁免。

sentences.en: Which almost all the rest of Republicans would find a carve-out for.
sentences.zh: 而几乎所有其他共和党人都会为此提供例外。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And so Massey has been viewed really as a sort of darling within certain elements of the Republican Party for being a purist, for basically saying,
sentences.zh: 所以马西在共和党内的某些派系中被视为某种宠儿，因为他是一个纯粹主义者，因为他基本上说，

sentences.en: when I say no increase in spending, I mean no increase in spending for anybody, including our military, including our allies in the Middle East, such as Israel.
sentences.zh: 当我说不增加开支时，我的意思就是不给任何人增加开支，包括我们的军队，包括我们在中东的盟友，比如以色列。

sentences.en: He's opposed Trump's intervention in both Venezuela and Iran, saying they betray the idea of America firSt.
sentences.zh: 他反对特朗普在委内瑞拉和伊朗的干预，称这背叛了“美国优先”的理念。

sentences.en: And so he's gotten by on that for some time, and he doesn't mind being a lone wolf, you know, tends to sit by himself in the House chamber, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以他这样过了一段时间，他不介意做一只独狼，你知道，倾向于独自坐在众议院议事厅里，你知道，

sentences.en: as sort of this off-the-grid cattle farmer who drinks raw milk.
sentences.zh: 就像那种喝生牛奶的隐居养牛户。

sentences.en: And so there is a kind of Paul Bunyan aspect to him.
sentences.zh: 所以他身上有一种保罗·邦扬式的传奇色彩。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And of all the ways that Massey, the maverick, the raw milk drinker, decided to go against the president, I think it's safe to say that the one he's going to be best known for
sentences.zh: 在马西这位特立独行者、生牛奶饮用者决定反对总统的所有方式中，我认为可以肯定地说，他最出名的一点，

sentences.en: and the one that is probably the most personally upsetting to President Trump is the way he decided to fight the president on Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 也是最让特朗普总统个人感到不安的一点，是他决定在杰弗里·爱泼斯坦问题上与总统对抗的方式。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this has been, I think, particularly vexing for Trump because he was never wholeheartedly for the release of the Epstein files, but his electoral base certainly was.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对特朗普来说特别令人恼火，因为他从来没有全心全意地支持公开爱泼斯坦的文件，但他的选举基本盘肯定支持。

sentences.en: And Massey took those desires literally and became the champion of releasing the files.
sentences.zh: 马西字面意义上采纳了这些愿望，并成为了公开这些文件的拥护者。

sentences.en: And at a time when Speaker Mike Johnson was being very, very deferential to Trump, if Trump doesn't want them released, that's fine,
sentences.zh: 在众议院议长迈克·约翰逊对特朗普非常、非常顺从的时候，如果特朗普不想公开它们，那没关系，

sentences.en: we'll recess the Congress rather than allow for a vote on the subject,
sentences.zh: 我们宁愿让国会休会，也不愿允许就此议题进行投票，

sentences.en: Massey remained insistent, began to work with a coalition that included the Democrat Ro Khanna, as well as a handful of other Republicans that all happened to be women,
sentences.zh: 马西仍然坚持己见，开始与一个包括民主党人罗·康纳以及其他几位恰好都是女性的共和党人在内的联盟合作，

sentences.en: and convened hearings, held press conferences with some of the women who were survivors of Epstein, and really became the public face of it.
sentences.zh: 召开了听证会，与一些爱泼斯坦的女性幸存者举行了新闻发布会，并真正成为了这件事的公众面孔。

sentences.en: Massey's determination was so great that Trump ultimately had to read the tea leaves and throw his own reluctant support behind the legislation,
sentences.zh: 马西的决心如此之大，以至于特朗普最终不得不看清形势，勉强支持了这项立法，

sentences.en: the Epstein Files Transparency Act, that in turn forced the Department of Justice to release those files.
sentences.zh: 即《爱泼斯坦文件透明法案》，该法案反过来迫使司法部公开了这些文件。

sentences.en: That was Massey and Ro Khanna's legislation.
sentences.zh: 那是马西和罗·康纳的立法。

sentences.en: Trump was against it, then he was for it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普起初反对，后来又支持了。

sentences.en: But that Trump essentially had to declare defeat was a moment that he clearly did not forget nor forgive Massey for.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普本质上不得不宣布失败，这一刻他显然没有忘记，也没有原谅马西。

sentences.en: So you go to Kentucky to try to figure out what that version of being a maverick within Donald Trump's Republican Party looks like to Republican primary voters
sentences.zh: 所以你去了肯塔基州，试图弄清楚在唐纳德·特朗普的共和党内做一个特立独行者，在共和党初选选民眼中是什么样子，

sentences.en: who are being told by the president to turn out Congressman Massey.
sentences.zh: 这些选民正被总统告知要投票赶走马西议员。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I did so because it's really difficult to obtain ground truth in any congressional primary from behind one's desk in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 我之所以这样做，是因为在华盛顿特区的办公桌后，很难在任何国会初选中获得实地真相。

sentences.en: But particularly, it's a complicated endeavor here because this is Trump country, after all.
sentences.zh: 但特别是在这里，这是一项复杂的任务，因为毕竟这是特朗普的地盘。

sentences.en: These are people who really, really love the president.
sentences.zh: 这些人真的、真的很爱总统。

sentences.en: And the idea of having a maverick congressman who they also like a great deal, but who is making the president from time to time look bad
sentences.zh: 而拥有一位他们也非常喜欢的特立独行的国会议员，但他却时不时让总统看起来很糟糕，

sentences.en: is not, generally speaking, what voters have in mind.
sentences.zh: 这通常不是选民们所想的。

sentences.en: And it's the voters who now are faced with a choice.
sentences.zh: 现在选民们面临着选择。

sentences.en: Their party leader has said, I want you to vote against Massey.
sentences.zh: 他们的党魁说，我希望你们投票反对马西。

sentences.en: I want you to vote for Ed Galrine.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们投票给埃德·加尔隆。

sentences.en: And now the question is, how important is that dictate from a president they so admire?
sentences.zh: 现在的问题是，他们如此钦佩的总统发出的指令有多重要？

sentences.en: So as the press is getting set up, this is a treat for all of us here in Boone County
sentences.zh: 所以当媒体准备就绪时，这对我们布恩县的所有人来说都是一种享受，

sentences.en: So about a week before the primary, Caitlin O'Keefe and I went to a Massey event in Boone County in the town of Burlington.
sentences.zh: 在初选前大约一周，凯特琳·奥基夫和我参加了在伯灵顿镇布恩县举行的一场马西活动。

sentences.en: This is the northern part of the district.
sentences.zh: 这是该选区的北部地区。

sentences.en: We welcome Mr. Massey.
sentences.zh: 我们欢迎马西先生。

sentences.en: It was an extremely well-attended event in the courthouse, standing room only.
sentences.zh: 法院里座无虚席，参加人数极多。

sentences.en: Take questions.
sentences.zh: 提问吧。

sentences.en: We have a microphone set up here.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里设置了麦克风。

sentences.en: How much time do we have?
sentences.zh: 我们有多少时间？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: At least 150 or so folks there.
sentences.zh: 至少有150人左右在那里。

sentences.en: I want to start out by saying, tell you what I have got done in the last six months of life.
sentences.zh: 我想先说一下，告诉你们我过去六个月的生活中完成了什么。

sentences.en: And Massey began it with a presentation of sort of his affirmative version of why a person should vote for him.
sentences.zh: 马西开始时展示了他为什么应该投票给他的肯定性理由。

sentences.en: First of all, I got a bill passed that has caused Prince Andrew to no longer be a prince.
sentences.zh: 首先，我通过了一项法案，导致安德鲁王子不再是王子了。

sentences.en: The British ambassador is no longer the ambassador to the United States.
sentences.zh: 英国大使不再是驻美大使了。

sentences.en: And the CEO of the World Economic Forum, that guy had to resign because of the Epstein Files transparency.
sentences.zh: 世界经济论坛的首席执行官，那个人因为爱泼斯坦文件的透明度而不得不辞职。

sentences.en: He very quickly moved into his advocacy of the release of the Epstein Files.
sentences.zh: 他很快转入了他对公开爱泼斯坦文件的倡导。

sentences.en: And he emphasized that while he is a tried-and-true Republican who has voted with the Republicans 91 percent of the time,

sentences.zh: “美国优先，肯塔基永远”，我喜欢这个，埃德。

sentences.en: So he said, President Trump cuts taxes.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，特朗普总统削减税收。

sentences.en: And right away, it became clear that his support for Trump, and for that matter, Trump's support for him, is really the message that he's running on.
sentences.zh: 很快就很清楚，他对特朗普的支持，以及特朗普对他的支持，确实是他竞选的核心信息。

sentences.en: I mean, he didn't talk about what committee assignments he would like to have.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他没有谈论他想进入哪个委员会。

sentences.en: He didn't talk about America's place in the world.
sentences.zh: 他没有谈论美国在世界上的地位。

sentences.en: He didn't talk about specific spending bills or really any legislation at all.
sentences.zh: 他没有谈论具体的支出法案，甚至根本没有谈论任何立法。

sentences.en: President Trump needed conservatives in Congress to deliver for the American people and what they voted for, what?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统需要国会的保守派为美国人民实现他们投票支持的目标，什么？

sentences.en: What he talked about with Trump.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了与特朗普有关的事情。

sentences.en: If I remember, nearly 78 million Americans voted for President Trump.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，近7800万美国人投票支持特朗普总统。

sentences.en: Trump won 31 states, is that right, including the swing states, and 312 electoral votes.
sentences.zh: 特朗普赢得了31个州，对吧，包括摇摆州，以及312张选举人票。

sentences.en: That is significant.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大。

sentences.en: That's a message.
sentences.zh: 这是一个信号。

sentences.en: And then after that...
sentences.zh: 在那之后……

sentences.en: But Thomas Massey stood in the way, not just against President Trump, but against the party in America.
sentences.zh: 但托马斯·马西挡了路，不仅是反对特朗普总统，而且是反对美国的政党。

sentences.en: He described how Massey was the person who was standing in the way of this agenda being passed.
sentences.zh: 他描述了马西是如何阻碍这一议程通过的人。

sentences.en: Kentucky deserves in America a congressman who will stand with President Trump, the Republican Party, and conservatives, not against him.
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州在国会需要一位与特朗普总统、共和党和保守派站在一起，而不是反对他的国会议员。

sentences.en: And that the 4th District deserved someone who was more in keeping with the man that they had voted for,
sentences.zh: 第四选区应该有一个更符合他们投票支持的那个人的人，

sentences.en: Donald Trump, and that he would be that man.
sentences.zh: 即唐纳德·特朗普，而他就是那个人。

sentences.en: So thank you all for coming here.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢大家的到来。

sentences.en: God bless President Trump, the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑特朗普总统，上帝保佑共和党。

sentences.en: God bless Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑肯塔基州。

sentences.en: God bless the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑美利坚合众国。

sentences.en: And I'll take a few questions.
sentences.zh: 我来回答几个问题。

sentences.en: Thank you all for coming.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家的到来。

sentences.en: Thank you all for coming, guys.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家的到来，伙计们。

sentences.en: And after that, he took about four questions from members of the press.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他回答了媒体成员提出的四个问题。

sentences.en: And in its guardrails-heavy nature, it seemed to be the exact opposite of Massey's free-form-anything-goes encounter that we'd had a couple of days earlier.
sentences.zh: 而且由于其严密的防范性质，这似乎与我们几天前经历的马西那种自由发挥、百无禁忌的互动完全相反。

sentences.en: And what do you think explains that decision-making?
sentences.zh: 你认为是什么解释了这种决策？

sentences.en: Well, it's that there's a paradoxical element of his campaign that while Trump desperately
sentences.zh: 嗯，他的竞选活动中存在一个矛盾的因素，虽然特朗普迫切希望马西被以压倒性的力量摧毁，

sentences.en: wants Massey to be crushed with overwhelming force, this campaign is kind of doing so with a very, very light footprint.
sentences.zh: 但这场竞选活动却以一种非常非常低调的方式进行。

sentences.en: And I think also is very careful about saying anything that could possibly offend the president
sentences.zh: 我认为他也非常小心，不说任何可能冒犯总统的话，

sentences.en: who has endorsed him, which was why when I had an opportunity during the Q&A, you know, I asked him, You did say a couple of minutes ago that you stand with President Trump.
sentences.zh: 因为总统支持了他，这就是为什么当我在问答环节有机会时，你知道，我问他：你几分钟前确实说过你支持特朗普总统。

sentences.en: And Thomas Massey has said that that's tantamount to you being a yes-man, a rubber stamp.
sentences.zh: 而托马斯·马西说这等同于你是一个唯唯诺诺的人，一个橡皮图章。

sentences.en: Are you going to be Trump's rubber stamp?
sentences.zh: 你会成为特朗普的橡皮图章吗？

sentences.en: And I wonder if you could comment on that, if you see yourself as someone who would be unswervingly with the president or someone who would be independent.
sentences.zh: 我想请你对此发表评论，你是认为自己会坚定地支持总统，还是会保持独立。

sentences.en: And what does he say?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么说的？

sentences.en: So first of all, I want to give you a scene center.
sentences.zh: 首先，我想给你们提供一个场景中心。

sentences.en: I guess I should have got five bronze stars to demonstrate my personal courage and independence to act on my own.
sentences.zh: 我想我本该获得五枚铜星勋章，以证明我个人的勇气和独立行事的自主性。

sentences.en: I guess I should have served three times at SEAL Team 6 instead of two.
sentences.zh: 我想我本该在海豹突击队第六分队服役三次，而不是两次。

sentences.en: But they have rules about that, and you don't want to do so much.
sentences.zh: 但他们对此有规定，你也不想做得太过火。

sentences.en: There's no point of importance about that.
sentences.zh: 那并没有什么特别重要的意义。

sentences.en: I've got to give thanks to other folks that did that.
sentences.zh: 我必须感谢其他做到这一点的人。

sentences.en: But it's a long way from a dairy farm in the Ohio River to SEAL Team 6, and I'm not talking geography.
sentences.zh: 但从俄亥俄河畔的一个奶牛场到海豹突击队第六分队，这路程很长，我指的不仅仅是地理距离。

sentences.en: You know, beyond describing his resume, he was essentially conflating individual courage with political independence, which struck me as two different things.
sentences.zh: 你知道，除了描述他的履历，他本质上是在把个人勇气和政治独立性混为一谈，这在我看来是两码事。

sentences.en: The president knows who I am.
sentences.zh: 总统了解我是谁。

sentences.en: He knows what I stand for.
sentences.zh: 他知道我的立场。

sentences.en: He knows exactly who he was talking to.
sentences.zh: 他非常清楚自己在和谁说话。

sentences.en: I am no rubber stamp.
sentences.zh: 我绝不是一个只会盖章的傀儡。

sentences.en: Will never happen.
sentences.zh: 那永远不会发生。

sentences.en: And said that being a rubber stamp was never who he was, nor who he would ever be.
sentences.zh: 并表示，做一个只会盖章的傀儡从来都不是他，将来也永远不会是他。

sentences.en: No, sir, E.
sentences.zh: 不，先生，E。

sentences.en: Bob, I'll put a bow on it with this.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃，我最后总结一下。

sentences.en: I represent these folks here.
sentences.zh: 我代表这里的这些人。

sentences.en: I'm their servant leader, and the president knows that.
sentences.zh: 我是他们的仆人式领导者，总统也知道这一点。

sentences.en: You can count on it.
sentences.zh: 你可以指望这一点。

sentences.en: But I wanted to push on that idea just to learn a little more from the candidate as to really just what he'd like to be as a congressman.
sentences.zh: 但我还是想深入探讨一下这个想法，只是为了从这位候选人那里多了解一点，看看他到底想成为什么样的国会议员。

sentences.en: So I paid him a call.
sentences.zh: 所以我拜访了他。

sentences.en: Robert Draper.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·德雷珀。

sentences.en: Hey, Robert, where you at now?
sentences.zh: 嘿，罗伯特，你现在在哪儿？

sentences.en: And what exactly did you ask him?
sentences.zh: 你到底问了他什么？

sentences.en: What did he say?
sentences.zh: 他说了什么？

sentences.en: And were you able to fully resolve this question of whether he was capable of being anything other than a Trump teammate?
sentences.zh: 你是否能够彻底解决这个问题，即他是否有能力成为特朗普队友之外的任何人？

sentences.en: Yeah, I started in our brief phone interview by asking him the most basic of questions.
sentences.zh: 是的，我在我们简短的电话采访中，首先问了他一个最基本的问题。

sentences.en: I'm just curious to know what House committees you'd like to serve on.
sentences.zh: 我只是好奇想知道你想在众议院的哪些委员会任职。

sentences.en: You're a man of varied interests, and you could go in a bunch of different directions.
sentences.zh: 你是一个兴趣广泛的人，你可以往很多不同的方向发展。

sentences.en: So what do you have in mind?
sentences.zh: 所以你有什么想法？

sentences.en: What's on your wish list?
sentences.zh: 你的愿望清单上有什么？

sentences.en: What House committees would he like to serve on?
sentences.zh: 他想在众议院的哪些委员会任职？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I'm going to go to Speaker Johnson and the president and J.D.
sentences.zh: 我会去找约翰逊议长、总统和J.D.。

sentences.en: I'm going to say, where do you need me, coach?
sentences.zh: 我会说，教练，你需要我做什么？

sentences.en: Just like when I played ball at Franklin Simpson, when I played ball at Center College, when I played ball at Murray, that is a team sport.
sentences.zh: 就像我以前在富兰克林辛普森打球，在中心学院打球，在默里打球时一样，那是一项团队运动。

sentences.en: Governing is a team sport.
sentences.zh: 治理国家是一项团队运动。

sentences.en: Now, I've got my desires.
sentences.zh: 现在，我有我的愿望。

sentences.en: I've got places I think I fit.
sentences.zh: 我有我认为适合我的位置。

sentences.en: But he knows what the whole ball team looks like.
sentences.zh: 但他知道整个球队是什么样子的。

sentences.en: Does that make sense?
sentences.zh: 这说得通吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: And the answer that he gave me was whatever the coach says.
sentences.zh: 他给我的回答是，教练怎么说就怎么做。

sentences.en: Speaker Johnson and President Trump would be the ones to make that decision for him and that he would happily abide by it.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊议长和特朗普总统将是为他做出决定的人，而他会欣然接受。

sentences.en: But, I mean, to state the obvious, this is quite different than Thomas Massey's vision of Congress, where independence is essential and the prerogatives of the Congress are to
sentences.zh: 但是，我的意思是，显而易见，这与托马斯·马西的国会愿景截然不同，在马西的愿景中，独立性至关重要，国会的特权在于

sentences.en: do what individual members think is necessary regardless of the team they're on, regardless of what the president wants.
sentences.zh: 做个别议员认为必要的事情，无论他们属于哪个团队，无论总统想要什么。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 那是对的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I pressed him later on whether he would have done as Massey did on the release of the
sentences.zh: 后来我追问他，如果是在发布爱泼斯坦文件这件事上，他是否会像马西那样做，

sentences.en: Epstein files, and he basically said, well, I'm for transparency, but I'm for transparency in a way that doesn't cause any conflict with the president.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，嗯，我支持透明度，但我支持的透明度方式是不会与总统产生任何冲突的。

sentences.en: And, you know, I asked him, would you be in favor of overthrowing the Cuban regime, for example?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我问他，比如你会支持推翻古巴政权吗？

sentences.en: And he said, I'm in favor of liberating the Cubans, but in whatever way the president wants to achieve that, I'm fine.
sentences.zh: 他说，我支持解放古巴人民，但无论总统想通过什么方式实现这一目标，我都同意。

sentences.en: So, in our brief conversation, at no point was there any suggestion that he would assert
sentences.zh: 所以，在我们简短的谈话中，没有任何迹象表明他会以个人身份主张

sentences.en: himself as an individual, instead he would be an enabler of whatever the Trump administration had in mind.
sentences.zh: 自己，相反，他会成为特朗普政府任何想法的推动者。

sentences.en: And look, to be fair, this is the calculation he's making, that if he's going to have a shot in this race, he's got to present himself as an alternative to Massey.
sentences.zh: 听着，平心而论，这是他正在做的算计，如果他想在这场竞选中有一线希望，他就必须把自己表现为马西的替代者。

sentences.en: And right now, Massey's biggest vulnerability is that he's lost the support of the president in a state where the president is very popular.
sentences.zh: 而现在，马西最大的弱点在于，他在一个总统非常受欢迎的州失去了总统的支持。

sentences.en: So, Galrine is running as the alternative to that.
sentences.zh: 所以，加尔莱恩正作为替代者参选。

sentences.en: And Galrine has an incredible financial war chest supporting him.
sentences.zh: 而且加尔莱恩拥有令人难以置信的财政资金支持。

sentences.en: And by supporting him, what I really mean is attacking Massey.
sentences.zh: 而所谓的支持，我真正的意思是攻击马西。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: You had said earlier that this race remains quite close.
sentences.zh: 你之前说过这场竞选仍然非常胶着。

sentences.en: And so, it's tempting to ponder all the implications of Massey surviving this, all the implications of Massey losing this race.
sentences.zh: 所以，人们很容易去思考马西幸存下来的所有影响，以及马西输掉这场竞选的所有影响。

sentences.en: But I wonder if, at the end of the day, those implications aren't so far apart.
sentences.zh: 但我怀疑，归根结底，这些影响是否真的相差那么远。

sentences.en: If Massey loses, Trump will have clearly shown that there's no tolerance for opposing him, even when somebody like Massey is staking out positions that are really grounded in what
sentences.zh: 如果马西输了，特朗普将清楚地表明，对于反对他的人是零容忍的，即使像马西这样的人所坚持的立场，实际上是基于

sentences.en: Trump claims his political movement is all about.
sentences.zh: 特朗普声称他的政治运动所代表的一切。

sentences.en: But even if Massey wins, the message to everyone else in the Republican Party is, do you really want to go through what I just went through in the name of independence from Trump?
sentences.zh: 但即使马西赢了，给共和党内其他所有人的信息是：你真的想为了从特朗普那里获得独立，而经历我刚刚经历的一切吗？

sentences.en: And the answer is probably no.
sentences.zh: 答案很可能是否定的。

sentences.en: So, either way, I might argue, Trump achieves his goal of imposing a very high degree of ideological
sentences.zh: 所以，无论哪种方式，我可能会说，特朗普都实现了他强加高度意识形态一致性的目标，

sentences.en: conformity, right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's definitely the case.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But it also comes with a certain risk, right?
sentences.zh: 但这同时也伴随着一定的风险，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, because we've just come out with this poll the New York Times has showing how on the generic ballot, Democrats are up by 10 or something.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，因为我们刚刚发布的这份《纽约时报》民调显示，在普通选票上，民主党人领先了10个百分点左右。

sentences.en: So, to basically, you know, wed yourself to Trump is really to be rolling the dice that this fidelity to the president is not going to prove damaging to the entire party.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上，你知道，把自己和特朗普捆绑在一起，实际上是在掷骰子，赌这种对总统的忠诚不会被证明对整个政党有害。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, I mean, it's, you know, Trump has basically sent this message, which I believe win or lose by Massey is still going to be present.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我的意思是，你知道，特朗普基本上发出了这个信息，我相信无论马西输赢，这个信息依然会存在。

sentences.en: But meanwhile, Republicans cannot be inattentive to this greater electoral message, these storm clouds that are gathering, suggesting that when it comes to general elections,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，共和党人不能忽视这个更大的选举信息，这些正在聚集的乌云表明，当涉及到大选时，

sentences.en: it's a deeply problematic thing, siding with the president.
sentences.zh: 站在总统这一边是一件非常成问题的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, if the midterms were held today, according to the New York Times poll that came out on Monday,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果中期选举在今天举行，根据周一发布的《纽约时报》民调，

sentences.en: the one you just referenced, it's very clear that Republicans would almost certainly lose the House based on all the factors you just described.
sentences.zh: 就是你刚才提到的那个，很明显，基于你刚才描述的所有因素，共和党人几乎肯定会失去众议院。

sentences.en: They wouldn't lose Massey's seat.
sentences.zh: 他们不会失去马西的席位。

sentences.en: Whether it's Massey or Galrine, it's going to be held by a Republican.
sentences.zh: 无论是马西还是加尔莱恩，它都将由共和党人把持。

sentences.en: But nationally, these polls suggest swing districts are going to swing Democratic.
sentences.zh: 但在全国范围内，这些民调显示摇摆选区将转向民主党。

sentences.en: And what Trump is saying to every Republican in this very expensive Massey race is, do not dare, trying to brake with me, even if I am steering this car off the midterm cliff.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普对这场昂贵的马西竞选中的每一位共和党人所说的是，不要试图与我决裂，即使我正把这辆车开向中期选举的悬崖。

sentences.en: Well, if Trump understands nothing else, he understands leverage.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果特朗普还懂什么的话，那就是他懂杠杆。

sentences.en: And he has always shown a willingness to use that leverage.
sentences.zh: 他一直表现出使用这种杠杆的意愿。

sentences.en: And that leverage includes no small element of fear.
sentences.zh: 而这种杠杆包含着不小的恐惧成分。

sentences.en: It does send a formidable message that you don't want to tangle with this guy.
sentences.zh: 这确实传递了一个强大的信息，即你不想和这家伙纠缠。

sentences.en: And we have not seen any president, I think, in modern history, perhaps in the history of
sentences.zh: 我认为我们还没有见过现代历史上，或许是美国政治史上，有哪位总统

sentences.en: American politics, who has had such command over his party, even in defiance of public opinion polls, that would suggest that people be a little bit wary of that fidelity to Trump.
sentences.zh: 对他的政党有如此强大的掌控力，即使在无视民意调查的情况下也是如此，而民调本应暗示人们对那种对特朗普的忠诚要保持一点警惕。

sentences.en: Well, Robert, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，罗伯特，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: My pleasure, Michael.
sentences.zh: 我的荣幸，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: We have never experienced a tragedy like this before.
sentences.zh: 我们以前从未经历过这样的悲剧。

sentences.en: It is extremely outrageous to target a place of worship.
sentences.zh: 针对礼拜场所的行为极其令人发指。

sentences.en: Police are investigating a deadly shooting at a mosque in San Diego as a hate crime.
sentences.zh: 警方正在将圣地亚哥一座清真寺发生的致命枪击事件作为仇恨犯罪进行调查。

sentences.en: Two teenagers shot and killed three people at the Islamic Center of San Diego, the largest mosque in San Diego County.
sentences.zh: 两名青少年在圣地亚哥县最大的清真寺——圣地亚哥伊斯兰中心枪杀了三人。

sentences.en: Investigators recovered anti-Islamic writing in the car where the two suspects were later found dead.
sentences.zh: 调查人员在后来发现两名嫌疑人死亡的汽车中找到了反伊斯兰的文字。

sentences.en: And on Monday, a jury rejected Elon Musk's lawsuit claiming that OpenAI, the artificial intelligence company he co-founded,
sentences.zh: 周一，陪审团驳回了埃隆·马斯克的诉讼，该诉讼称他共同创立的人工智能公司OpenAI

sentences.en: had violated its original mission by putting commercial interests over the good of humanity.
sentences.zh: 通过将商业利益置于人类福祉之上，违反了其最初的使命。

sentences.en: Jurors did not rule on the merits of Musk's argument.
sentences.zh: 陪审团没有对马斯克论点的实质内容做出裁决。

sentences.en: Instead, they found that Musk brought his lawsuit against OpenAI and its chief executive, Sam Altman, after the statute of limitations had expired.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们认定马斯克是在诉讼时效过期后才对OpenAI及其首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼提起诉讼的。

sentences.en: The Trump administration has created an unusual $1.8 billion fund overseen by the president's allies
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府设立了一个不同寻常的18亿美元基金，由总统的盟友监管，

sentences.en: to compensate those who claim they were politically targeted by the Justice Department under President Biden.
sentences.zh: 旨在补偿那些声称在拜登总统任期内受到司法部政治针对的人。

sentences.en: He wants to set up a fund that is completely under the control of his sycophants and cronies,
sentences.zh: 他想设立一个完全由他的谄媚者和亲信控制的基金，

sentences.en: that he can literally direct them to give money to this or that person based on personal favor.
sentences.zh: 他可以亲自指挥他们根据个人喜好将钱给这个人或那个人。

sentences.en: Democratic officials called it a taxpayer-financed slush fund that would enrich Trump's supporters.
sentences.zh: 民主党官员称这是一个纳税人资助的行贿基金，将使特朗普的支持者中饱私囊。

sentences.en: And they predicted it would make payouts to, among others, those convicted of participating in the January 6th riots at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们预测该基金将向包括那些因参与1月6日美国国会大厦骚乱而被定罪的人在内的群体进行支付。

sentences.en: Capitol.
sentences.zh: 国会大厦。

sentences.en: There's no rule of law or rhyme or reason to any of it.
sentences.zh: 这一切都没有法治，也没有任何道理可言。

sentences.en: It is just a slush fund, and it has got to be stopped.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个行贿基金，必须被制止。
